sn32.57:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn32.57:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenekadā devo vassatīti.
sn32.57:1.6: ‘yannūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti’. tesaṃ taṃ cetopaṇidhimanvāya devo vassati.
sn32.57:1.7: ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenekadā devo vassatīti.
sn32.57:1.10: valāhakavaggo paṭhamo. (vitthārena sattapaññāya suttantā bhavanti.) tatruddānaṃ :
